scripts.build:apk: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && echo 'APK generado en: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
scripts.build:apk:debug: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && echo 'APK Debug generado en: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'
scripts.build:bundle: cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd .. && echo 'AAB generado en: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab'
scripts.build:apk:all: pnpm run clean:android && pnpm run build:apk
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules .expo android/app/build android/.gradle ios/Pods ios/build
scripts.clean:full: pnpm run clean && rm -rf android ios
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run prebuild:clean
scripts.rebuild:android: pnpm run clean:android && pnpm run prebuild:clean && pnpm run build:apk
